summary: Isolate website embeds from real-app storage and browser history, measure their containers for responsive layout, and preserve accessible pending-state landmarks without leaking document CSS into stories.

compatibility.detail: Live workspace defaults retain browser navigation and persistence. Embed builds use memory-only storage and navigation; dock widths can be explicitly nonpersistent.

manual.detail: No migration. pnpm --dir apps/fractal-web test:embed proves the built iframe entry.
